notes.title: Are you ready for 2 new modes?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/c25600c7aa55c75c6ae46a9e598c9080fd6034dc.png[/img]

As you might know, we are currently working on new ways for you to play JetX so we now want to tell you about two new game modes coming very soon!

The first one is a Free-For-all playground. This mode will be open 24/7, meaning that you can play anytime. Here you can test your shooting and racing skills against anyone else that enters, and you can stay in it as long you want to.

Are you ready for:

- Multiple game modes

- Live leaderboard

- Wide choice of weapons

notes.title: JetX is on its way to release!
notes.content:
[url=https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/4d288a10d42889b85ebea0f03dc5bde93b95a60d.png][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/e39fbe688caa2d158ed01e2f8601367219a75446.png[/img][/url]

Prepare your VR helm for endless races and fights!

Those who still do not know why they will play JetX, read further. We are developing arcade racing for VR and PC in which, besides the awesome races, you can also smash (bang! phew-phew!) other players in different game modes. JetX does have incredible speeds and explosive gameplay that will literally turn your head!

Intrigued? We have MOAR!
[list]
[*] 6 different types of weapons and a variety of power-ups, for h-h-h-ot shooting
[*] Awesome PVP fights with other players
[*] Several game modes: Race, Arena, DeathMatch, Energy Core and even PVE (this is a blast at all!)
[*] 8 different levels for these modes
[*] Multiplayer in all modes: with or without VR-helmet
[*] Freedom of movement in virtual reality, designed specifically for VR
[*] Bots that can own you
[*] Supports Oculus Rift, HTC Vive and a special version for PC
[/list]

And there will be more levels, game modes, weapons and something special!

Put JetX on your [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684620/JetX/]wishlist[/url] and take a look on our full of awesomeness [url=http://jetx.online/]website[/url]!

See you in VR soon, pilot!

notes.title: JetX Development Update #2
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/6d3b667f02232bd064a477763cb0354ac058b473.jpg[/img]
New arena map: Crystal Hive

[h1]Hello Everyone![/h1]

[h1]Currently we are at the final stage of development before the JetX release. We are very excited about what’s coming and hope you are too. Stay tuned for upcoming news![/h1]

[h1]Join our [url=https://discord.gg/QjWj9sf]Discord Server[/url]for more news, updates and support.[/h1]

[h1]Changelog:[/h1]

[h1]PC version[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Now JetX supports PC, HTC Vive, Oculus and Mixed Reality. You can play with your friends all across these platforms without any limitation.
[/list]
[h1]Party system[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New party invitation system in the game makes playing with friends easier than ever! Just hop in and enjoy JetX right away!
[/list]
[h1]Insane bots[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Want to practice and sharpen your skills? Try our new Insane bots but be aware, they are named Insane for a reason.
[/list]
[h1]New FX[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Numerous visual FX added to make your experience even better.
[/list]
[h1]New Game Mode[/h1]
[list]
    [*]New Energy core game mode with thrilling gameplay. The objective is to capture the Energy core. The player who will hold it for 100 seconds - wins!
[/list]
[h1]New map[/h1]
[list]
    [*]Added fascinating new Crystal Hive map with 2 Game Modes: Deathmatch and Energy Core.
[/list]

With best regards [url=http://singularity.kz/en/]Singularity Lab[/url]

See you in the game!

notes.title: Big announcement!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/b190030e0b5a4fc33484bb0dec7a78d7266ae360.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone!

First of all, we want to apologize for delaying the release. We really love VR and JetX is a great game for experienced VR players. But nonetheless, the reality is that VR multiplayer games have very low online which results in a quick dry-out of servers and death of the game.

We had only one idea of how to make JetX last for a long time. And now we are happy to introduce you a PC version of JetX! VR and non-VR players now can play together in our fast-paced game. Every platform has their pros and cons, and while initially the game was designed only for VR, we are really proud of how PC version feels. To keep the balance we changed some things, but overall it is the same experience.

We are polishing a few last things and going to release very soon!

Stay tuned,
Singularity Team

P.S. Check out our new cool trailer for PC version!

notes.title: JetX Development Update #1
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/89037df092ea7ef1bf273f2c3a3e4c961a5fd131.jpg[/img]
[h1]Long Time No See[/h1]

Hey guys, how are you doing? So it's been a long time since we had a proper “update” post that would let you know all about the changes made to the game and news from the inside of Singularity Lab. We will start releasing this kind of posts, every week. So stay tuned for more awesome news!

Let's get right to business and start with some news regarding JetX. As you may have noticed, we moved the release date. During the final testing phase we found some bugs that needed our attention and after fixing them we realized that some core mechanics can be added in order to make JetX even more exciting. Here are some of the new features and updates that have been or are being added right now:

[u]1) Matchmaking Upgrade[/u] - if you participated in our OBT, then you might have seen the way matchmaking work in JetX. We had no lobbies implemented and the only way for you to play with friends was - joining to the same server, at once. Not really the best solution for a game focused heavily on the multiplayer aspect, right? 

At the moment our team is working on adding Steam lobbies to JetX, tweaking some matchmaking parameters and adding in the ability to create matches of your own.


[u]2) Single Player Campaign[/u] - we thought for a long time about this and came to a conclusion that JetX needs a Singleplayer Mode. We did add bots, but bots won't keep you in-game for a long time. This new mode will be available for co-op as well. Our level designers are working on new maps for single player, and we are testing new mechanics that are designed specifically for this mode. Soon we will show you what we have so far and for now take a look at our new concept art, prepared by the one and only Arlan:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/950da0e3acca81bdf48fe7d1915faa93eb498c1d.jpg[/img]

[u]3) Weapon Switching[/u] - we have introduced a new way of switching weapons and the tutorial has been updated for it. This new mechanic makes switching weapons in-game more intuitive and simpler. You can check out the updated tutorial [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=1189577483]here[/url]

[u]4) Bugs, Bugs and More Bugs[/u] - here at Singularity we strive for perfection, we want to bring you a carefully crafted, polished game that will bring you nothing but joy. 

So this is it for today! Thank you for your time and stay tuned for the next update!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/53e9354b4936b9f106fc88936a2215c1c67ff2ec.jpg[/img]

Signing out,
Sam.

notes.title: OBT for JetX
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/d3824c20b9ca735ba202f217b51801f5e7001440.gif[/img]
Before we start I would like to point out that you can already sign up to our OBT on the JetX website: [url=http://jetx.online/]http://jetx.online/[/url]

Hello, everyone! 

We decided that it is time to talk about our OBT in more detail.

[h1]Whats the current status?[/h1]

We are fixing bugs in our client. We are almost finished but we are surer when exactly we will be ready. In the previous post, we mentioned the OBT is planned to start on 20 of October and will last till the 23rd. 

Unfortunately, we couldn't finish in time. 

[h1]So when is the OBT?[/h1]

Can't say anything for sure right now. The dates have been moved by 1 week, so that means we are trying our best to finish everything by 27th of October.

[h1]How long will OBT last?[/h1]

The OBT will start on Friday and last 3 days. During those days anyone will be able to play and test JetX for free. We also plan to host free OBT weekends, weekly.

notes.title: JetX is on Steam!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30920381/7ea0f4c2ceb21e7ab3be641d483f3bb4cc991b75.jpg[/img]
[h1]We are happy to announce that JetX is officially on Steam![/h1]

Check our Steam page and our Steam Community for daily updates! Who knows maybe you will find your wingman here.


[h1]Open Beta Test - Comming Soon![/h1]

Currently, we are finishing up our last preparations and testing the hell out of JetX. We are preparing our client and servers for an OBT, in order to make sure that the game performs at its best, once you receive it. 

Thank you all, who already signed up for our OBT, you will receive a conformity email soon!

[i]But can you give us approximate dates?[/i]

Sure thing. But don't 100% rely on those. If everything goes as planned and no new bugs come up, and all the server part will perform excellently then we plan to start the OBT on 20nd of October till 22nd. 

Thank you all once again and we hope to see you in the game, shortly!
